description: This file contains source code for converting between MKLDNN (oneDNN) tensors and dense tensors, as well as reordering weights for MKLDNN optimized operations in PyTorch. It includes functions for tensor format conversions, weight reordering for convolutions and linear layers, and serialization utilities, primarily targeting CPU and MKLDNN backend optimizations.

methods.description: Converts an MKLDNN tensor to a dense tensor with optional data type and masked gradient parameters.

methods.name: Tensor dense_to_mkldnn(const Tensor & cpu_tensor,std::optional<ScalarType> dtype)
methods.description: Converts a dense CPU tensor to an MKLDNN tensor with optional data type.
